name: Weapon Mastery
description: Increased damage with all melee weapons.

name: Armor Specialization
description: Gain bonus armor from all equipped armor pieces.

name: Critical Block
description: Your blocks can now critically block for double reduction.

name: Deep Wounds
description: Your critical strikes cause the enemy to bleed.

name: Blood and Thunder
description: Thunder Clap also applies Rend to affected enemies.

name: Taste for Blood
description: Dealing damage has a chance to make your next attack free.

name: Wrecking Ball
description: Your attacks have a chance to trigger a free Slam.

name: Die by the Sword
description: When below 20% health, gain increased parry chance.

name: Second Wind
description: Regenerate health when stunned or immobilized.

name: Enrage
description: Being critically hit enrages you, increasing damage dealt.

name: Blood Craze
description: Critical hits regenerate a portion of your health.

name: Impending Victory
description: Killing an enemy heals you for a percentage of max health.

name: Double Time
description: Your charge ability can hold two charges.

name: Piercing Howl
description: Your shouts pierce enemy resistances.

name: Sudden Death
description: Auto attacks have a chance to make Execute usable at any health.

name: Meat Cleaver
description: Your attacks cleave to hit additional targets.

name: Indomitable
description: Reduces the duration of stun and incapacitate effects.

name: War Machine
description: Killing blows generate rage and increase movement speed.

name: Furious Charge
description: Charging generates additional rage.

name: Endless Rage
description: All rage generation is increased by 10%.

name: Seasoned Soldier
description: Increased stamina and physical damage reduction.

name: Skull Banner
description: Your battle standards last longer and are more effective.

name: Booming Voice
description: Shout abilities affect a larger area.

name: Vigilance
description: You take reduced damage when protecting an ally.

name: Shield Barrier
description: Blocking attacks grants a damage absorb shield.

name: Heavy Repercussions
description: Shield Slam deals bonus damage based on your block value.

name: Sword and Board
description: Devastate has a chance to reset Shield Slam cooldown.

name: Hold the Line
description: Critical blocks increase your critical strike chance.

name: Bastion
description: When you block, nearby allies take reduced damage.

name: Anger Management
description: Every rage spent reduces the cooldown of major abilities.

name: Battle Trance
description: Extended combat increases your attack speed.

name: Storm Bolt
description: Your throwing abilities stun the target.

name: Focused Rage
description: Mortal Strike and Execute deal bonus damage.

name: Opportunity Strikes
description: Your auto attacks deal additional damage.

name: Trauma
description: Your bleed effects deal increased damage.

name: Unquenchable Thirst
description: Bloodthirst has no cooldown but deals reduced damage.

name: Raging Blow
description: While enraged, your attacks can strike twice.

name: Single-Minded Fury
description: When using a single two-handed weapon, deal bonus damage.

name: Titans Grip
description: Can equip two-handed weapons in one hand.

name: Battle Hardened
description: Your maximum health is permanently increased.
